reason: Speculative Actions accelerates general agentic systems by predicting and executing likely future API actions in parallel, with LLM calls among a broader set of tool/MCP/human actions. Its evaluations cover gaming, e-commerce, web search and an OS setting, reporting up to 20% latency reduction, but do not isolate LLM inference latency or serving throughput. Retained as borderline because it includes LLM-agent loops while its objective/evaluation extends well beyond LLM inference.
title: Speculative Actions: A Lossless Framework for Faster Agentic Systems
